en.title: [ROTC] Recruitment Announcement for the 67th and 68th ROTC Cadet Cohorts in the Second Half of 2026
summary: Recruiting the 67th and 68th Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC) cadets for the second half of 2026.
Eligible applicants are 1st and 2nd-year male and female undergraduate enrolled students (재학생) or students on leave of absence (휴학생) who meet the birth date criteria for each cohort.
The application period is from August 31, 2026 (Mon) to October 13, 2026 (Tue) at 24:00.
Applications can be submitted online via the Army Cadet Military School website (acq.armyofficer.mil.kr).
Please refer to the attached announcement files for detailed schedules and required documents.
en.easyExplanation: The ROTC is recruiting 67th and 68th cadet cohorts for the second half of 2026. If you are a 1st or 2nd-year male or female student currently enrolled (재학생) or on a leave of absence (휴학생) and meet the age requirements, you can apply online through the Army Cadet Military School website by October 13 (Tue) at 24:00.
en.target: 1st and 2nd-year undergraduate male and female enrolled students (재학생) or students on leave of absence (휴학생) (67th cohort: born between Mar 2, 1999 and Mar 1, 2009 / 68th cohort: born between Mar 2, 2000 and Mar 1, 2010)
